Sample.evidence_source: This paper focuses on suicides of 12 men because we gained information about each suicide from multiple participants (two to seven close relatives and friends).

Country.evidence_source: The setting for the study was Accra, the capital of Ghana with an urban population of 2.27 million (Ghana Statistical Service, 2012).

Population.evidence_source: We purposively sampled 15 certified suicides that occurred in Accra and its environs between 2014 and 2015 by persons aged 15 years and above. There were 14 men, all Christians. This paper focuses on suicides of 12 men because we gained information about each suicide from multiple participants (two to seven close relatives and friends). We selected 43 close relations and friends (hereafter participants) of the deceased persons through purposeful and snowballing techniques.

Area.evidence_source: The rapid growth of Accra's urban population has created a great need for housing and related infrastructure (Konadu-Agyemang, 2001), contributing to psychosocial burdens among residents (Canavan et al., 2013).
